label: TP
reason: User input from request parameter flows through doSomething() (which extracts first word via split) into str variable, then directly into Cookie constructor without sanitization. Although ESAPI.encodeForHTML() is called on the printed output, the cookie value itself is never validated/sanitized. Attackers can inject arbitrary strings including potential XSS payloads into cookies, which browsers process differently than HTML rendering.

evidence.note: Parameter flows to Cookie without sanitization; encodeForHTML only protects printed output, not cookie value
